fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: A crushing hoof-strike that deals 28 blunt damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ringing Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves outward and deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them 2.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Barred Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% and your physical resistance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hard to Dent
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 15%. You gain 5% dodge chance.
